integrity: All-field theorem justified algebraically; four finite-field parameter cases are independently checked by an executable enumerator, not treated as proof. Only self-review has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Standard Heisenberg Lie algebras over fields; the rank polynomial requires finite fields. General 2-step nilpotent Lie algebras and non-idempotent derivations are excluded. Analogous enumerations under alternate terminology may exist.
title: Idempotent derivations of Heisenberg Lie algebras: all-characteristic orbits and finite-field rank spectra
